metrics.name: ingest.wall_s
metrics.description: Initial ingest: from adding the files source to every file indexed (scan, extract, chunk, embed, store)

metrics.name: ingest.files_per_s
metrics.description: Initial ingest throughput in files

metrics.name: ingest.chunks_per_s
metrics.description: Initial ingest throughput in chunks (each embedded)

metrics.name: ingest.mib_per_s
metrics.description: Initial ingest throughput in file bytes

metrics.name: ingest.chunks
metrics.description: Chunks produced by the initial ingest

metrics.name: ingest.embed.ms_per_1k_chunks
metrics.description: Initial ingest: time spent in embedding calls per 1,000 chunks embedded (sum of call durations; calls may overlap)

metrics.name: ingest.embed.ms_per_1k_items
metrics.description: Initial ingest: time spent in embedding calls per 1,000 items (files)

metrics.name: ingest.embed.share_of_wall
metrics.description: Initial ingest: embedding call time over ingest wall time (capped at 1)

metrics.name: ingest.embed.chars_per_chunk
metrics.description: Mean characters per embedded chunk (task prefix included when the model has one)

metrics.name: resources.db_bytes_per_1k_items
metrics.description: Encrypted database on disk (main file + WAL + SHM) after the initial ingest, per 1k items. Includes fixed overhead (sqlite-vec allocates vectors in blocks of 1024), so small corpora overstate it

metrics.name: query.latency.p50_ms
metrics.description: Retriever::search latency (hybrid + MMR, query embedding included), median

metrics.name: query.latency.p95_ms
metrics.description: Retriever::search latency (hybrid + MMR, query embedding included), 95th percentile

metrics.name: query.latency_convex.p50_ms
metrics.description: Retriever::search latency (hybrid with convex fusion + MMR, query embedding included), median

metrics.name: query.latency_convex.p95_ms
metrics.description: Retriever::search latency (hybrid with convex fusion + MMR, query embedding included), 95th percentile

metrics.name: query.embed.p50_ms
metrics.description: Query embedding call latency during known-item retrieval, median

metrics.name: query.embed.p95_ms
metrics.description: Query embedding call latency during known-item retrieval, 95th percentile

metrics.name: freshness.p50_s
metrics.description: Median time from a file operation on disk to Retriever::search reflecting it (real watcher, pipeline and store)

metrics.name: freshness.p95_s
metrics.description: 95th-percentile file-operation-to-searchable time (M1 exit criterion: at most 60 s)

metrics.name: freshness.max_s
metrics.description: Worst file-operation-to-searchable time (timeouts count at the timeout)

metrics.name: freshness.changes
metrics.description: File operations measured (edits, creates, deletes, renames)

metrics.name: freshness.timeouts
metrics.description: File operations not reflected in search within the timeout

metrics.name: freshness.edit.p95_s
metrics.description: 95th-percentile time until a file edit is reflected in search

metrics.name: freshness.insert.p95_s
metrics.description: 95th-percentile time until a file insert is reflected in search

metrics.name: freshness.delete.p95_s
metrics.description: 95th-percentile time until a file delete is reflected in search

metrics.name: freshness.rename.p95_s
metrics.description: 95th-percentile time until a file rename is reflected in search

metrics.name: propagation.edit_rate
metrics.description: Share of file edits fully reflected in search within the timeout (new content found; old content, deleted items and old paths gone)

metrics.name: propagation.insert_rate
metrics.description: Share of file inserts fully reflected in search within the timeout (new content found; old content, deleted items and old paths gone)

metrics.name: propagation.delete_rate
metrics.description: Share of file deletes fully reflected in search within the timeout (new content found; old content, deleted items and old paths gone)

metrics.name: propagation.rename_rate
metrics.description: Share of file renames fully reflected in search within the timeout (new content found; old content, deleted items and old paths gone)

metrics.name: propagation.final_keys_match
metrics.description: After all changes: Jaccard overlap of indexed item keys and files on disk

metrics.name: propagation.final_content_match
metrics.description: After all changes: share of changed files still on disk whose current content finds them

metrics.name: freshness.ingest_reported.p95_s
metrics.description: Ingest's own p95 from a change reaching the pipeline to committed (excludes the watcher debounce and the search), from Ingest::status

metrics.name: resources.db_bytes
metrics.description: Encrypted database on disk (main file + WAL + SHM) at the end of the run

metrics.name: resources.peak_rss_mib
metrics.description: Peak resident set size of the whole benchmark process (store, ingest, watcher, retriever, embedder and the harness itself), from /proc/self/status VmHWM
